TRAINING DAYS
Before or during training

02
ACTIVE DAYS
Support the daily system

03
CONSISTENCY
Make creatine automatic

Mix 1 scoop with water. Use daily as part of your training, hydration, and nutrition routine.

Fortius Aqua is the output engine. Pair it with other Legacy Sanctum protocols based on what your day demands.

websiteDescription.value: Elevate your hydration routine with Passion Fruit HYDRATION, a delicious drink that combines essential electrolytes to keep you hydrated and energized. Ideal for any activity level, from marathon gaming to marathon running, HYDRATION delivers pure, clean refreshment with a delightful, uplifting taste. Enjoy the unique, sweet taste of Passion Fruit in a convenient, tasty form.Key Highlights of Passion Fruit HYDRATION:• Premium Formulation: Our formula avoids fillers and unnecessary additives, focusing on delivering essential nutrients.*• All-Day Consumption: Suitable for consumption throughout the day.*• Keto Friendly: Designed to fit into various dietary lifestyles.*• Various nutrients: Contains essential nutrients to support overall health.*• Supports Muscle Function: Helps maintain proper muscle function and endurance.*• Enhances Endurance: Boosts stamina for both physical and mental activities.*• Caffeine-Free and Uplifting Taste: Enjoy the refreshing taste without caffeine or sugar.*Ideal For:• Athletes: Supports hydration and endurance for high-energy activities.*• Professionals & Students: Helps maintain hydration and focus throughout the day.*• Anyone Seeking Hydration: Perfect for those looking to stay hydrated and healthy with a clean, refreshing drink.*Discover the Difference:HYDRATION is more than just a drink; it’s a commitment to supporting your active lifestyle and helping you stay hydrated and energized. With a focus on balance, wellness, and taste, it's time to move beyond sugary drinks and temporary fixes. Embrace the clean, sustained hydration of our Passion Fruit HYDRATION and feel the difference in your day.Ready for a Refresh?Try our Passion Fruit HYDRATION today and experience the pure, clean refreshment of Passion Fruit flavor.Ingredients: Vitamin B1 (Thiamin), Vitamin B2 (Riboflavin), Vitamin B3 (Niacin), Vitamin B6 (Pyridoxal 5 Phosphate), Vitamin B9 (Folate), Vitamin B12 (Methylcobalamin), Calcium (Calcium Citrate), Magnesium (Magnesium Citrate), Sodium (Sodium Citrate), Potassium (Potassium Citrate), Polydextrose, Citric Acid, Natural & Artificial Flavors, Sucralose, Calcium Silicate, Fruit & Vegetable Blend (for color)Flavor: Passion FruitManufacturer's country: USAProduct amount: 5.71 oz / 0.36 lb / 162 gGross weight (oz/lbs/g): 7.2 oz / 0.45 lbs / 204 gSuggested use: Measuring with the scooper located inside the jar, mix each scoop, to desired taste, with 14-20 ounces (414-591 ml) of water (2 scoops with 28-40 ounces (828 ml-1.2 1) of water).Warning: Recommended to not exceed more than 5 scoops within a 24 hour period. Not intended for use by persons with a medical condition. Consult your physician before using this product if you are pregnant of nursing or taking any medication.Manufactured in a facility that produces Milk, Eggs, Fish, Shellfish, Tree Nuts, Peanuts, Wheat, Soybeans, and Sesame.Store in a cool dry place, keep out of reach of children. Do not use if safety seal is broken or missing. Contents sold by weight not volume, some settling may occur. Secure lid tightly when not in use. Consume within 90 days.This product is intended to supplement a balanced diet and active lifestyle. HYDROS
ELECTROLYTE HYDRATION + B VITAMINS
Hydration-driven. Electrolyte-powered. Built for daily output.
A clean daily hydration formula built with essential electrolytes and B vitamins to support fluid balance, energy metabolism, muscle function, and training readiness — without caffeine and without a heavy sugar profile.*
Electrolyte Hydration Support*
Fluid Balance Support*

Muscle Function Support*
Choose Your Flavor

DAILY HYDRATION PROTOCOL
BUILT FOR THE DAYS YOU REPEAT.
Use Hydros as a daily hydration protocol for workdays, training, heat, sweat, and the repeatable routines that demand steady support without caffeine or stimulants.*
01
Morning Start
Start the day with hydration support before coffee, training, or work begins.*
02
Training + Sweat
Use around training, heat, or sweat-heavy days to support electrolyte replenishment.*
03
Workday Output
Keep hydration part of the system during long shifts, focus blocks, and daily movement.*

Evening Reset
Use as a caffeine-free hydration option when you want support without stimulants.*
